languages.bonus: Celestial, Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Sylvan

traits.name: Elven Immunities
traits.summary: Immune to magical sleep and gain +2 on saves against enchantment.

traits.name: Elven Magic
traits.summary: Gain +2 on caster-level checks to overcome spell resistance and +2 Spellcraft to identify magic items.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.summary: See twice as far as humans in dim light.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.summary: Gain traditional elven weapon proficiencies and treat elven weapons as martial.

alternateTraits.name: Desert Runner
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +4 on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves against fatigue, exhaustion, running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, and harsh environments.

alternateTraits.name: Dreamspeaker
alternateTraits.summary: Increase the DC of divination spells and sleep effects by 1; with Charisma 15, use dream once per day.

alternateTraits.name: Eternal Grudge
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +1 on attack rolls against humanoids of the dwarf and orc subtypes.

alternateTraits.name: Lightbringer
alternateTraits.summary: Become immune to light-based blindness and dazzle, count as one level higher for light effects, and with Intelligence 10 use light at will.

alternateTraits.name: Silent Hunter
alternateTraits.summary: Reduce the Stealth penalty while moving by 5 and make Stealth checks while running at -20.

alternateTraits.name: Spirit of the Waters
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +4 Swim, always take 10 while swimming, allow Aquan as a bonus language, and gain longspear, trident, and net proficiency.

alternateTraits.name: Woodcraft
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +1 Knowledge (nature) and Survival, increasing to +2 in forests.
